scopeNote: The GA-P2-PERF-01 baseline (artifacts/perf-index-review-01.json, key adminBundleBaseline) is the ADMIN bundle: its top chunks (DataGrid, UserContext, MUI X) exist only in admin. The customer frontend was never baselined and is untouched by this slice.
method: Official `npm run build` in admin/ (ts:build + rolldown-vite), byte totals over admin/build/ (files, total bytes, JS/CSS split, entry file size, top chunks by size). Identical script for before and after.
baselineReproduced: Before any change, a fresh official build reproduced the GA-P2-PERF-01 baseline byte-for-byte including chunk hashes (13,986 modules transformed; entry index-BnTWAUft.js).

changes.detail: main.tsx statically imported fr/es/en locale objects for @mui/material, @mui/x-date-pickers and @mui/x-data-grid into the entry chunk (~27 KB rendered). The theme is built once at boot from the already-resolved language, so the three locale modules are now loaded with await import() and only the active language's objects are passed to createTheme. Post-build attribution: zero locale modules remain in the entry chunk; rolldown emits per-package lazy locale chunks fetched at boot (grid locales-DvRQZaRj.js 16,390 B; pickers locales-CBqq3aIF.js 4,146 B + enUS-DFb3YswD.js 2,071 B; material locale-ChsvE_X5.js 1,999 B).

Chain packages/bookcars-helper -> ':currency-converter' (packages/currency-converter) -> easy-currencies pulled a second, nested axios 1.13.2 (browser build 71,178 rendered bytes) into the shared UserContext chunk, beside admin's own axios 1.21.0. Added 'axios': path.resolve(__dirname, 'node_modules/axios') to resolve.alias, following the config's existing react/react-dom pattern. easy-currencies only uses axios.create()/GET. Post-build attribution: nested copy eliminated; a single axios remains.

Admin source uses exactly two validator functions (isMobilePhone in the four form models; isURL in utils/helper.ts) but imported the whole library (~68 KB rendered in the UserContext chunk: isTaxID 27,843; isIdentityCard 11,536; index 11,526; isMobilePhone 9,217; isVAT 7,867). Files now import validator/es/lib/isMobilePhone and validator/es/lib/isURL directly. Post-build: validator footprint is 10,522 rendered bytes in UserContext (isURL + deps) plus a dedicated lazy isMobilePhone chunk (7,781 B final).

notDone.candidate: Per-language splitting of the 58 localized-strings lang modules (GA-P2-PERF-01 future candidate)
notDone.reason: Attribution shows they are not concentrated in the initial chunks: only lang/cars.ts (16,246 rendered) and lang/common.ts (13,163 rendered) sit in the UserContext chunk; the other 56 modules already live in lazy route chunks. Every module statically embeds all four locales behind a synchronous LocalizedStrings API read at render by ~100 components; splitting requires restructuring module shape plus async language loading, which is not behavior-preserving.
